---
title: v3.0.1 — Unified Install Root and Isolated Host Skill Discovery
---

## Overview

Agent Work Kit 3.0.1 consolidates each installation under one managed root and limits Host Skill discovery entries to Work and Tooling links. This prevents unrelated third-party Skills in the Host directory from being treated as part of the installation.

## Highlights

- Replace the installer option `--skills-dir` with `--install-dir`. The default root is `~/.agents/agent-work-kit` for Codex and `~/.claude/agent-work-kit` for Claude Code; a custom root must be specified again on reinstall.
- Install Work, Tooling and Shared under `<install_dir>/skills`, binaries under `<install_dir>/bin`, and the single installation state at `<install_dir>/install-state.json`. Keep the Release ZIP README outside the installed root.
- Create only Work and Tooling absolute directory symbolic links in the fixed Host Skills directory. Reuse verified links on reinstall and reject occupied, missing, damaged or mismatched links without taking over unrelated Skills. Windows does not fall back to junctions when symbolic link creation fails.
- Keep Skills, binaries, state, discovery links and optional Global Instructions in one protected installation transaction. Strengthen failure recovery across directories and Windows volumes, including link creation and permission failures.
- Update Source, Package and downloader installation checks and Host simulations for the new layout. Cross-platform automated coverage includes Codex and Claude Code packages on macOS and Windows; Host discovery is verified through scripted simulation.

## Compatibility

The previous `--skills-dir` option and installation layout are not migrated automatically. Existing unknown or incompatible installation contents are preserved and rejected until the user selects a safe installation target.
